summary: Pritzker endorsed Senate resolutions to block U.S. arms sales to Israel in 2025 and distanced himself from AIPAC in 2026. Yet he downplayed Chicago's 2024 Gaza ceasefire resolution for not holding Hamas accountable, framed the 2023 conflict around 'peace and human rights for both Israelis and Palestinians,' and in May 2026 stated criticism of Israel is 'crossing into antisemitism.' His record condemns humanitarian harm while directing accountability at Netanyahu rather than U.S. structural support for Israel.
